reference.configuration: Yubari, ONI 41-42, April 1943. Six 140 mm guns in two twin and two single positions, one trunked funnel, and two twin torpedo launchers. Original early main-battery arrangement, before 1944 removal of the single guns. The source armor inset is an intelligence approximation; it does not redefine catalog armor.
